test_alias_rule: test the basic alias rule by building targets referenced through an alias and verifying only expected outputs are created
test_alias_source_usage_requirements: test that usage requirements like preprocessor defines propagate through an alias to dependent executable targets
run_boostbuild_tester: run a BoostBuild.Tester instance to write jamroot.jam files, source files, and execute build system tests
test_alias_single_target: test building a single aliased target and verify only that target's object and executable files are produced
test_alias_multiple_targets: test building an alias referencing multiple targets and verify each target's build outputs are created correctly
